records.title: A compact and flexible FPGA accelerator for regular and octave convolutional neural networks
records.reason: Abstract concerns regular/octave CNN convolution acceleration on FPGA (MobileNetV2/ResNet-50), not language or Transformer inference; no plausible direct lineage link beyond generic FPGA acceleration.

records.title: Towards Faster and More Compact Foundation Models for Molecular Property Prediction
records.reason: The work reduces molecular-property foundation-model fine-tuning cost and model size for chemistry prediction. The abstract indicates a domain-specific training/finetuning objective rather than LLM inference improvement or a plausible LLM lineage.

records.title: Memorization: A Close Look at Books
records.reason: The paper studies extraction of memorized books from LLMs and correlation with popularity/duplication; it does not propose an inference optimization.

records.title: Low-Bit Integerization of Vision Transformers Using Operand Reordering for Efficient Hardware
records.reason: hardware-oriented vision-transformer quantization, not language-model work, so transfer to BERT/LLM remains uncertain.

records.title: Decreasing Word Error Rates in Paragraph Handwritten Text Recognition with Synthetic Data
records.reason: The abstract is about synthetic paragraph data for handwritten-text recognition and dataset scarcity, not model inference efficiency.
